Order an MLE ScoreBooking live music acts is a major recurring outlay — tens of thousands of euros a year for smaller venues, and into the millions for the largest venues and festivals — yet the vast majority of those commitments are made without a pre-event, econometric demand-scoring tool like our MLE Score: a fine approach for proven acts, but arbitrary and potentially costly for everything else — emerging acts, untested dates, and even household names whose real pull on this coast is unknown. At €49 — affordable enough to test multiple acts, dates and price points year-round — you get a much better look — including a projected audience draw — before you leap.

Live music events in Costa del Sol

246 live music events in Costa del Sol (11 OCT–7 DEC 2026) — including Los Migrantes, Brunch Electronik Weekender, Malú and more. Concerts, festivals, DJ sets, flamenco and free gigs, updated weekly.

From Málaga city to Marbella, Estepona and Nerja, Costa del Sol packs Andalusia's busiest live-music calendar — beach-club sets, historic-theatre concerts, summer festivals and flamenco nights all along the coast.

Málaga Live is the trusted 8‑language guide to live music across Málaga city & Costa del Sol — with 244 events listed for 11 Oct–7 Dec 2026, including Malú, OBK, Gemelos Tour 2K26, Camela, No Te Va a Gustar, Vetusta Morla, Festival Internacional de Jazz de Málaga, Hijos de la Ruina Tour and more.
